beats.headline: Died five times, and stronger for it
beats.text: A pet-class mob. The System’s notice for one that has not yet bonded to a crawler reads like a card on a cage: this one has died five times, and its stats are all buffed by 125% because of it. It has five weaknesses, which can be examined only by whoever bonds with it or holds it in a carrier.

beats.headline: Bonded on one bowl of chowder
beats.text: Carl lets the level-one tummy acher out onto the table, and it hops straight into Mongo's open mouth. Mongo swallows, then yaks it back up, giggling. Carl's food box now serves everything chowder style, so his breakfast sandwich comes crumbled into seafood soup; he puts the bowl down, the meatball dives in, growls at Mongo, and its dot turns orange. One bowl, and bonded. Then it pushes the bowl over to Mongo. The naming window will not close until Louis comes up with a knight's name built on Ren's.
